# Cocktail From What I Have

Curated by Skill Harbor — a cocktail skill that starts from reality instead of a shopping list: name the bottles, mixers and gear you actually have, and it produces two or three cocktails you can build tonight, with real ratios, a clear method (shake/stir/build), glass and ice guidance, sensible substitutions for what you're missing, a batching note for groups, and a genuine zero-proof version that isn't just juice. Includes quality checks (every drink buildable from the stated inventory) and anti-patterns it refuses (recipes needing a shop run, no measurements, mocktails without balance). Discovered via skills.sh, listed here with credit to its creator by @mohitagw15856. Honest caveats: focused and narrow — it's one workflow done well, not a full mixology course; output quality depends on how completely you list your shelf. MIT licensed. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. Not verified.
